verdict.rationale: Netlify documents deploying to a global CDN, plus cache controls including Stale-While-Revalidate, on-demand cache invalidation and a programmatic Cache API. That covers the core of serving static assets through edge caching. One community comment is mildly positive about Netlify's edge products, but none measures speed. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on edge locations and default static-asset caching behavior, independent or hands-on evidence that assets are actually served faster.

support.subject: As a developer, I can serve static assets faster using a global CDN with edge caching

citations.quote: Deploy to a global CDN in seconds
Control & customize cache behavior, including Stale-While-Revalidate (SWR), on-demand cache invalidation, a programmatic Cache API, and more.
They are 'super happy with the netlify build/edge products.'
